notes: “the soundtrack is by ... yb sky h1 and alicia crampton who these days is known as um chiki mamani condori ... i'm gonna play that now”

The artist is real (formerly Elysia Crampton). The track played was from the Luma Pizza: Akin Paraíso soundtrack, most likely the Credits track (see entry 3). I couldn't confirm the exact track online.

rows.title: Mi Refugio
notes: 2024 EUPHONIA
“later on we're going to have a selection from boris of course boris from nahui”

rows.title: Credits (Luma Pizza: Akin Paraíso soundtrack)
notes: “at the top we had sky h1 alicia crampton and yb with the credits track from their soundtrack”

Chuquimamani-Condori (also credited as Joshua Chuquimia Crampton, formerly Elysia Crampton), with YB and Sky H1, on the Luma Pizza: Akin Paraíso soundtrack. I couldn't find the Credits track page itself, so this links to the artist's Bandcamp.

rows.title: Fountain (ars amatoria)
notes: “Lyra Pramuk with a remix by Vessel of a track off her album Delta”
Vessel's reworking of Lyra Pramuk's Fountain, track 8 on the 2021 remix album Delta (Bedroom Community).

rows.title: Flickering
notes: “That was the wonderful Seven With Feet with a track called Flickering”
The artist is Serpent With Feet (Josiah Wise). "Flickering" was his debut single on Tri Angle, produced by The Haxan Cloak.

rows.title: Dumb
notes: “the next track is called dumb with four m's and it's by chakra effendi”

rows.title: Straight to Hell
notes: “that followed on from Hate Rock with a version of Straight to Hell”

rows.title: Melt
notes: “Rainbow Chan with a beautiful track called Melt There off her second album Pillar”
"Melt" is track 6 on Rainbow Chan's 2019 album Pillar. The "There" in the announced title is probably ASR noise.

rows.title: Possessed
notes: “this is a a very long song called Possessed, combining Pip's soaring, beautiful kind of reverb-drenched vocals”

Circular Keys' "Possessed" appears on the 2013 Eurogrand/Possessed vinyl, and the band also has the album Sorry! on Bandcamp. I didn't confirm that the track matches the long, reverb-heavy vocal description.

rows.title: Zero and Position
notes: “that was the song Zero and Position by the, you know, postcard core, I guess, band Ohana”

rows.title: Sleepless in Sydney
notes: “my disco were a huge influence on ohana... you're listening to sleepless in sydney”

rows.title: European Jewel
notes: “So we're going to hear Jandek's European Jewel.”

"European Jewel" closes Jandek's 1978 debut Ready for the House (as the abruptly cut-off "Incomplete" take). Longer versions are on Chair Beside a Window and The Rocks Crumble. The Bandcamp link is a cover by BBJr.

rows.title: The Roof
notes: “this is a track called the roof you're listening to sleepless in sydney”
First single from friendships' 2016 debut LP Nullarbor 1988-1989 (Mansion / Dot Dash).

rows.title: Heaven (Radio Edit) [Timofey & Bartosz Brenes vs. Terri B]
BONUZZZZ: meta-limbs remixxedremasteredd
notes: “That one was called Metalim's Remixed Remastered.”
A bonus remix and remaster of "meta-limbs" on Female Wizard's 2023 album What A Body Can Do.

rows.title: Early Exposure to Television
notes: “next up i'm going to play you a track off an ep from the excellent steeplejack label from melbourne this is dbr”
From DBR's (Yoni Bresley) 2021 release Transient Attention Complex on Melbourne's Steeplejack Records.

rows.title: Shifter
notes: “And Nina Buchanan with Shifter of Restless Abandon”
A track on Nina Buchanan's 2021 album Restless Abandon (Heavy Machinery Records / Flash Forward Melbourne).

rows.title: New Year, New Paranoia
notes: “we had Janna Quill, just then the legendary Janna Quill with New Year, New Paranoia of her self-titled release”
From Jannah Quill's self-titled 2021 release. The artist's name is spelt Jannah.

rows.title: The World I Want Would Be Celestial, Wet
notes: “A really beautiful one there by Nick Ashwood from the Absorb compilation, The World I Want Would Be Celestial Wet”

Nick Ashwood (Sydney, from Tasmania) appears on Absorb's compilation The World I Want Would Be Celestial, Wet. The compilation title is also the track title the presenter gave, and I couldn't confirm a separate track by that name.

notes: “i want to play you the closing track by third space ... this one's called phasing fifths”
